author: MistaArthur6967
quote: Besides the horrendous amount of bugs, glitches, and messed up features, this game just doesn’t feel like GTA whatsoever. From limiting your freedom to the main characters just **** and not being likable. Writing is the worst, pacing is the complete opposite of the past GTA games and paywalling the completed game behind the “ultimate edition” is just pure laziness and greed. Should be called the incomplete edition and complete edition. Forgot to mention that the game is ‘targeting’ 30 fps in the big 26 on apparently the strongest console, the PS5. The Xbox series X runs it the best with S running it surprisingly well and for cheaper. Either the PS5 is not actually as strong or the devs are just really good when it comes to working with the XBOX. All the endings **** too. Little spoiler, a character from a past game returns and out of all the ones they decided to bring back, they chose the one that canonically left the crime lifestyle behind, retconning the ending and a conversation in GTA V. Rockstar stopped being Rockstar when Dan Houser left
